title: Fix Semio Diagram Diff Theme Colors
description: Fix semio/ui Diagram diff preview colors so modified, added, and removed states render as distinct semantic colors instead of collapsing to the selection blue. Extend semio/ui globals.css with color-modified, color-new, and color-removed variables derived from the theme, update the diagram component to use them correctly, and verify semio/ui type-check and Storybook build.
summary: Added semantic semio/ui theme variables for new, modified, and removed diagram colors, updated Diagram to use those theme tokens, and changed selection styling so it no longer overwrites diff operation colors. Re-verified semio/ui type-check and Storybook build.
